definition: the activity of elections and governing
description: In an animated town square, two rival candidates - a woman in an orange suit and a man in teal with a green rosette - stand on crates shouting "Vote for me!" while the crowd waves orange and green fans. Votes are painted as orange and green bars on a big board; the orange side wins a rosette, and the two candidates shake hands saying "Well done. Good luck!".
transcript: Vote for me, friends! No! Vote for me! Yeah! Well done. Good luck!
